description: This file defines custom data frame classes for the OpenAI Realtime API integration within the Pipecat framework. It includes data classes for representing updates to context messages and function call results, with deprecated warnings indicating that these types are no longer actively used internally by the API.

classes.name: RealtimeMessagesUpdateFrame
classes.description: Data class representing an update of the realtime context messages with a field for the OpenAIRealtimeLLMContext.

classes.name: RealtimeFunctionCallResultFrame
classes.description: Data class encapsulating the function call result frame for the realtime API, containing a FunctionCallResultFrame.
